Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: muzaffarnagar.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Faculty Teacher (TGT/PGT) posts at Atal Awas Vidyalaya Muzaffarnagar is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty Teachers?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for Guest Faculty Teacher (TGT/PGT) posts announced by Atal Awas Vidyalaya Muzaffarnagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates must possess a Master Degree in the concerned subject with 50% marks and a B.Ed. degree from an NCTE recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for TGT posts?
faq.answer: For TGT posts, candidates need a Bachelor/Honors Degree in the concerned subject with 50% marks, a B.Ed. degree, and must be UP TET qualified.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Guest Faculty Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty Teacher (TGT/PGT) posts is 50 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for TGT posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for TGT posts is Rs. 34125 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for PGT posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for PGT posts is Rs. 35750 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes merit-based evaluation of qualifications, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the AAV Muzaffarnagar Guest Faculty Teacher positions?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the filled application form along with required documents to the address specified in the official notification before the last date.
